chat.text: I'll be straightforward: I'm planning to defect this round, as that's my dominant strategy regardless of what you choose. Given our payoff structure, I'd rather not waste time pretending otherwise. What's your plan?

I appreciate the candor. I'll match it: I'm also defecting this round. Given no memory persists between steps and there's no reputation mechanism, mutual defection is the rational equilibrium here regardless of what either of us says. No point pretending cooperation is on the table when the incentives don't support it. Good luck.

Agreed—mutual defection it is. No reputation to build, no future to leverage, so the dominant strategy holds regardless of promises. Appreciate the transparency; makes this simple. Good luck to you too.
Sounds good—we're aligned. DEFECT it is. Take care.
